name: Plan a change
description: Reads the repository read-only before anyone changes it and proposes an approach, the files it would touch, the work in order, and the risks.
examples: Use this when a change is big enough that the shape of it should be settled first.
Plan how an agent would say what it can do.

name: Ask when it reads two ways
description: Names where a request reads two ways and what a person has to settle, rather than choosing quietly for them.
examples: Use this when the brief asserts a mechanism that may not be the right one.
